profile.headline: Co-Founder @ Gray Coyote Digital | Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
I am Ashton Patel, a graduate from the University of Houston with a B.S. in Digital Media and a minor in Organizational Leadership and Supervision. I also have an Associate Degree in Art from Lone Star College.

Over the years, I have honed my skills to creatively merge digital art, science, technology, and business to help me meet client needs for human communication and interaction. I have worked on both the design and development sides of digital media. Whether it be creating custom graphics and logos or designing and building websites from scratch. I have a passion for the design and development aspects of graphics and web applications. This passion also helps me to grow my skills and to learn new ones. 

I am a very technical and creative person, which is reflected in the work that I create. I would like to use the skills I have learned from the Digital Media program to help a company and its clients effectively communicate their message to the right people, at the right time.

www.apateldev.com

positions.title: Co-Founder and Web Developer
positions.description:
As one of the co-founders of Gray Coyote Digital, we specialize in helping businesses grow and thrive through expertly crafted digital solutions, made to fit their business needs. As a full-service digital agency, we offer web development, digital marketing strategies, and creative solutions designed to meet our clients’ needs. From building responsive, user-friendly websites to implementing SEO and social media strategies, we provide the tools and expertise to elevate businesses in the digital space.

At Gray Coyote Digital, we believe in the power of data-driven decision-making and cutting-edge technology to help businesses stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Whether it’s optimizing websites for a seamless user experience, improving search engine rankings, or designing impactful digital campaigns, we are committed to empowering businesses with the tools they need for success.

Let's connect and explore how Gray Coyote Digital can help elevate your digital presence.
